description: The early-2000s return finds Pat and Mat back among puzzles, indoor cookouts, roof work, cameras, wheeled furniture, doghouses, painting, greenhouse construction, mice and security schemes, with domestic life once again functioning as an endless workshop.

s08e01.description: Pat and Mat sit down with a large jigsaw puzzle and quickly abandon ordinary piece-by-piece patience in favor of pins, air flow, sweeping and other methods that treat puzzling like construction work.

s08e02.description: They want to roast sausages without leaving the apartment, so Pat and Mat bring the cookout indoors and keep redesigning the arrangement whenever smoke, heat or practicality objects.

s08e03.description: A leaking roof sends Pat and Mat into another repair job, where getting materials and themselves into the right place becomes as difficult as sealing the original problem.

s08e04.description: An antique camera fascinates Pat and Mat, but taking a photograph of themselves requires them to understand the mysterious box and invent a way to operate it from the other side of the lens.

s08e05.description: A bargain on wheels convinces Pat and Mat that household furniture would be better if it moved, and one rolling table soon inspires a much broader campaign of adding mobility to the room.

s08e06.description: Before getting the large dog Pat wants, the pair decide to build a suitably substantial doghouse, treating the future pet's accommodation as a full-scale construction project.

s08e07.description: A paint spill leaves the floor marked, so Pat and Mat decide to repaint the entire room. The challenge becomes how to cover every part of the floor without painting themselves into a corner.

s08e08.description: Pat and Mat build a greenhouse in the yard, combining masonry, glazing and improvised construction methods until one small planning mistake threatens the usefulness of the whole structure.

s08e09.description: A toy of two figures on a swing gives Pat and Mat the urge to build the real thing, turning a simple garden amusement into another exercise in supports, balance and mechanical ingenuity.

s08e10.description: A mouse takes up residence in the house, and Pat and Mat respond with an escalating series of traps and contraptions designed to outsmart a guest considerably smaller than either of them.

s08e11.description: Mat worries that a valuable art object might be stolen, so he and Pat turn the house into a security project with increasingly elaborate ways of guarding one precious possession.

s08e12.description: Painting the window frames begins with a falling paint can and broken glass, leaving Pat and Mat to solve not just the painting but how to keep their improvised work platform and materials under control.
